name: progress
description: The native progress element as a thin bar in a hue, filled to its value, or striped and moving when it has none.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the filled part.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The bar's thickness: half the size's space step.

attributes.name: data-scroll
attributes.description: Fill with how far the nearest scroll container has been scrolled, the page when the bar is at its top, instead of with a value: a reading-progress bar. On a block with the class, not a progress element, and hidden from assistive tech; where a scroll timeline is unsupported the bar is not shown.

tokens.name: --yeti-progress-radius
tokens.description: Corner of the bar and of its value.

tokens.name: --yeti-progress-size
tokens.description: Thickness of the bar; overrides the size step.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-on-primary
tokens.description: Text on the default variant's color.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-md
tokens.description: The text step when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The space step when data-size is absent; the bar's height follows it.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-base
tokens.description: How long the value takes to move; one cycle of the indeterminate sweep is four of it.

tokens.name: --yeti-ease
tokens.description: The curve of the value's move.

tokens.name: --yeti-motion-iterations
tokens.description: How many times the indeterminate sweep repeats; one under reduced motion.

a11y.notes: Put the class on a progress element and give it a name with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Keep its text content current ("40%"), since older assistive tech reads that. Leave out value for work whose length is unknown; the element is then indeterminate and says so. A reading-progress bar has no value to announce, so it carries aria-hidden instead of a name; the rule accepts either.
